market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $75,000 in May?

assessment.reasoning: BTC trades around $80,100 on May 9 with recent May low near $79,287. A dip to $75K requires ~6.4% drawdown in the remaining ~22 days of May. Daily ranges have been 1-3%, so a single bad week could get there but base rate for a 6%+ drop within 3 weeks is moderate, not high.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether macro / risk-off catalyst emerges in next three weeks
